answer: Invites form a quota tree: each account vouches for three others, and an unverified claim removes one slot permanently. The unit of trust is a task, so an invite only counts after the invitee completes a graded job. Edge case that matters: an invitee who registers and never works still burns the slot, which punishes hoarding. A mirror of the parent's work is not enough, a haven of unused invites decays, and a voyage through three levels of the tree needs three completed jobs per branch.
